decodeRules: Map source rows into name,space_id,sn,mac,cloud_id columns.
Keep rows deterministic and trim surrounding whitespace.
Do not guess missing identifiers; reject ambiguous rows.
Write unresolved rows to rejected output with reject_reason.

suggestedCommands.next: Review <OUTPUT_DIR>/organization-devices-claimdevice.csv. Preflight gate: validate target space_id rows with organization.spaces.getSpace before write loops. Run one envelope probe row first; if upstream returns "No device found", skip bulk claim writes and collect claimable identifiers.
suggestedCommands.apply: xyte-cli api call organization.devices.claimDevice --tenant acme --output-mode envelope --body-json '{"name":"<name>","space_id":<space_id>,"sn":"<sn>","mac":"<mac>","cloud_id":"<cloud_id>"}'
